> **A note on this prompt**
> This document was researched and authored by Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant,
> using live sources from August 26–29 2026. All casualty figures, coordinates,
> and timeline events are sourced and cited. The agentic pipeline wires directly
> to Nepal's government disaster APIs so the app always draws from the highest-authority
> data available — not just news scraping.

## Project Identity

Name: `nepal-flood-map`
Stack: Next.js 14 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Mapbox GL JS · Recharts · Anthropic API
Output: deployable web app — `npm run dev` at localhost:3000

---

## Phase 0 — Scaffold

```bash
npx create-next-app@latest nepal-flood-map \
  --typescript --tailwind --app --src-dir --import-alias "@/*"
cd nepal-flood-map
npm install mapbox-gl @types/mapbox-gl recharts lucide-react date-fns
npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk
```

### `.env.local`
Never hardcode keys. Copy this and fill in values:
```
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN=pk.eyJ1...
CRON_SECRET=                        # openssl rand -hex 32
NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000
NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY=                 # optional — free at firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/
```

## Phase 1 — Types (`src/types/flood.ts`)

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Type definitions
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Severity     = "critical" | "high" | "medium";
export type LocationType = "origin" | "border" | "settlement" | "town" | "district" | "junction" | "region";
export type AlertLevel   = "critical" | "warning" | "info";

export interface FloodOrigin {
  name:        string;
  lat:         number;
  lng:         number;
  time:        string;
  description: string;
  district:    string;
  type:        "origin";
}

export interface FloodLocation {
  id:       number;
  name:     string;
  lat:      number;
  lng:      number;
  time:     string;
  district: string;
  type:     LocationType;
  severity: Severity;
  detail:   string;
}

export interface TimelineEvent {
  time:   string;
  event:  string;
  detail: string;
  source: string;
}

export interface ActiveAlert {
  level:        AlertLevel;
  title:        string;
  detail:       string;
  dismissible?: boolean;
}

export interface MissingByNationality {
  country: string;
  count:   number;
  source:  string;
}

export interface LiveStats {
  deaths_nepal:        number;
  deaths_tibet:        number;
  deaths_total:        number;
  missing_nepal:       number;
  missing_foreigners:  number;
  missing_americans:   number;
  rescued:             number;
  impacted_total:      number;
  powerloss_mw:        number;
  bridges_destroyed:   number;
  roads_destroyed_km:  number;
  trucks_swept?:       number;
  countries_affected?: number;
  last_updated:        string;
  source:              string;
  fallback?:           boolean;
}

export interface GDACSAlert {
  alertLevel: "green" | "orange" | "red" | null;
  title:      string | null;
  link:       string | null;
}
```

## Phase 3 — Data Source Registry (`src/data/dataSources.ts`)

This file is the single source of truth for every external API and feed the app uses.
The agentic refresh route reads from this registry in priority order.

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Agentic Data Source Registry
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
//
// Priority order: govt APIs → UN → scientific → news aggregation → static fallback
// The /api/refresh route works through these in sequence, stopping at first success.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const DATA_SOURCES = {

  // ── TIER 1: Official Nepal Government ──────────────────────────────────────

  BIPAD: {
    name:       "BIPAD — Nepal Disaster Information Management System",
    priority:   1,
    url:        "https://bipadportal.gov.np/",
    apiKey:     false,
    updateFreq: "near-real-time during events",
    dataType:   "JSON REST API",
    endpoints: {
      incidents:  "https://bipadportal.gov.np/api/v1/incident/?format=json&page_size=20",
      realtime:   "https://bipadportal.gov.np/api/v1/real-time-monitoring/?format=json",
    },
    notes: "Nepal govt official disaster platform. No auth needed for public read. " +
           "Highest authority for deaths/missing/rescued. Lag: 2-6 hrs after field update.",
  },

  NEPAL_POLICE: {
    name:       "Nepal Police HQ — Official Press Releases",
    priority:   2,
    url:        "https://www.nepalpolice.gov.np/",
    apiKey:     false,
    updateFreq: "on-event",
    dataType:   "HTML (scrape)",
    scrapeSelector: ".press-release, .news-item",
    notes: "Primary official source for casualty figures. " +
           "Scrape the press release section for structured announcements.",
  },

  NDRRMA: {
    name:       "National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority",
    priority:   3,
    url:        "https://ndrrma.gov.np/en",
    reportsPath: "/reports",
    apiKey:     false,
    updateFreq: "daily during events",
    dataType:   "PDF SITREPs + HTML",
    notes: "Download PDF situation reports from /reports. " +
           "Best for structured overview data, coordination status.",
  },

  // ── TIER 2: UN / International ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  RELIEFWEB: {
    name:       "UN OCHA ReliefWeb API",
    priority:   4,
    url:        "https://reliefweb.int/country/npl",
    apiKey:     false, // use appname param — no registration needed
    updateFreq: "hourly",
    dataType:   "JSON REST API",
    endpoints: {
      reports:
        "https://api.reliefweb.int/v1/reports?" +
        "appname=nepal-flood-map&" +
        "filter[conditions][0][field]=country.iso3&" +
        "filter[conditions][0][value]=NPL&" +
        "filter[conditions][1][field]=date.created&" +
        "filter[conditions][1][value][from]=2026-08-26&" +
        "sort[]=date.created:desc&limit=5&" +
        "fields[include][]=title&fields[include][]=date&fields[include][]=body",
    },
    notes: "Aggregates OCHA, UNDP, IFRC SITREPs. " +
           "Best for funding data, coordination updates, downloadable reports.",
  },

  GDACS: {
    name:       "Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (JRC/UN)",
    priority:   5,
    url:        "https://www.gdacs.org/",
    apiKey:     false,
    updateFreq: "every 15 minutes",
    dataType:   "RSS + JSON",
    endpoints: {
      rss:    "https://www.gdacs.org/xml/rss.xml",
      events: "https://www.gdacs.org/gdacsapi/api/events/geteventlist/FLOOD",
    },
    notes: "Critical for secondary event detection — specifically the Tibet barrier lake. " +
           "Will fire orange/red alert if new flood event registered upstream. Poll every 5 min.",
  },

  // ── TIER 3: Scientific / Satellite ─────────────────────────────────────────

  USGS_SEISMIC: {
    name:       "USGS Earthquake Hazards — Landslide / Seismic Monitor",
    priority:   6,

    apiKey:     false,
    updateFreq: "real-time",
    dataType:   "GeoJSON",
    endpoints: {
      realtime: "https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/all_day.geojson",

      nepal2026:
        "https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?format=geojson" +
        "&starttime=2026-08-26&endtime=2026-09-05" +
        "&minmagnitude=4" +
        "&minlatitude=27&maxlatitude=30&minlongitude=84&maxlongitude=87",
    },
    notes: "Confirmed M5.2 landslide signal at 02:52:10 UTC Aug 26. " +

  },

  COPERNICUS_EMS: {

      "https://www.nbcnews.com/world/asia/live-blog/live-updates-massive-flash-flood-nepal-tibet-border-hundreds-missing-rcna594643",

      "https://earthsky.org/earth/nepal-flash-flood-glacier-collapse-landslide-aug-26-2026/",
      "site:apnews.com nepal flood 2026",

      "https://english.onlinekhabar.com/",
```

## Phase 4 — GDACS Poller (`src/lib/gdacs.ts`)

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — GDACS RSS poller
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
//
// Polls UN's Global Disaster Alert feed every 5 minutes.
// Critical right now: detects the Tibet barrier lake secondary event before news breaks.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import type { GDACSAlert } from "@/types/flood";

export async function checkGDACS(): Promise<GDACSAlert> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("https://www.gdacs.org/xml/rss.xml", {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
      next:   { revalidate: 300 }, // Next.js ISR cache — revalidate every 5 min
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { alertLevel: null, title: null, link: null };

    const text = await res.text();

    // Find <item> blocks mentioning Nepal
    const itemRegex = /<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/gi;
    const items     = [...text.matchAll(itemRegex)].map((m) => m[1]);
    const nepalItem = items.find((i) => /nepal|bhote|trishuli/i.test(i));

    if (!nepalItem) return { alertLevel: null, title: null, link: null };

    const title = nepalItem.match(/<title><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]><\/title>/)?.[1]
               ?? nepalItem.match(/<title>(.*?)<\/title>/)?.[1]
               ?? null;
    const link  = nepalItem.match(/<link>(.*?)<\/link>/)?.[1] ?? null;

    // GDACS encodes alert level in gdacs:alertlevel or severity field
    const rawLevel = (
      nepalItem.match(/gdacs:alertlevel>(.*?)</i)?.[1] ??
      nepalItem.match(/alertlevel.*?['"](green|orange|red)['"]/i)?.[1] ??
      ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const alertLevel =
      rawLevel === "red"    ? "red"    :
      rawLevel === "orange" ? "orange" :
      rawLevel === "green"  ? "green"  : null;

    return { alertLevel, title, link };
  } catch {
    return { alertLevel: null, title: null, link: null };
  }
}
```

## Phase 5 — Agentic Refresh Route (`src/app/api/refresh/route.ts`)

Multi-source pipeline. Tries BIPAD → ReliefWeb → Anthropic → static fallback.
Never returns an error to the client — dashboard always renders.

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Agentic data refresh route
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
//
// POST /api/refresh
// Tries data sources in priority order. Returns latest verified stats as JSON.
// Falls back to static data on any failure — never returns 5xx.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import Anthropic        from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { LIVE_STATS }  from "@/data/floodData";
import type { LiveStats } from "@/types/flood";

const client = new Anthropic();

// ── Source 1: BIPAD Nepal Govt API (highest authority, no key needed) ─────────
async function fetchBIPAD(): Promise<Partial<LiveStats> | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://bipadportal.gov.np/api/v1/incident/?format=json&page_size=20",
      { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(7000) }
    );
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const data = await res.json();

    const incident = (data.results ?? []).find((r: Record<string, unknown>) =>
      String(r.title ?? "").toLowerCase().includes("bhote") ||
      String(r.title ?? "").toLowerCase().includes("flood") ||
      String(r.date  ?? "").startsWith("2026-08-26")
    );
    if (!incident) return null;

    return {
      deaths_nepal:  (incident.death    as number) ?? null,
      missing_nepal: (incident.missing  as number) ?? null,
      rescued:       (incident.rescued  as number) ?? null,
      source:        "BIPAD Nepal Government Portal",
      last_updated:  (incident.updated_at as string) ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ── Source 2: UN OCHA ReliefWeb (no key needed — just appname param) ──────────
async function fetchReliefWeb(): Promise<Partial<LiveStats> | null> {
  try {
    const url =
      "https://api.reliefweb.int/v1/reports?" +
      "appname=nepal-flood-map&" +
      "filter[conditions][0][field]=country.iso3&filter[conditions][0][value]=NPL&" +
      "filter[conditions][1][field]=date.created&filter[conditions][1][value][from]=2026-08-26&" +
      "sort[]=date.created:desc&limit=3&fields[include][]=title&fields[include][]=date";
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const data = await res.json();
    const latest = data.data?.[0];
    if (!latest) return null;
    // ReliefWeb confirms there are active SITREPs — update timestamp only here
    return {
      source:       `ReliefWeb/OCHA: ${latest.fields?.title ?? "Nepal SITREP"}`,
      last_updated: latest.fields?.date?.created ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ── Source 3: Anthropic web_search — reads live news ─────────────────────────
async function fetchViaAnthropic(): Promise<Partial<LiveStats> | null> {
  if (!process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) return null;
  try {
    const response = await client.messages.create({
      model:      "claude-sonnet-4-6",
      max_tokens: 1000,
      tools:      [{ type: "web_search_20250305", name: "web_search" }],
      system:
        "You are a disaster data analyst monitoring the August 26 2026 Nepal glacial flood " +
        "(Bhote Koshi / Lhende Khola). Search for the LATEST confirmed official figures from " +
        "Nepal Police, Nepal Army, NDRRMA, or major wire services (AP, Reuters, ABC News, NBC News). " +
        "Ignore early estimates — use only the most recent confirmed figures. " +
        "Return ONLY valid JSON with these exact keys (all numbers must be numeric type): " +
        '{"deaths_nepal":number,"deaths_tibet":number,"deaths_total":number,' +
        '"missing_nepal":number,"missing_foreigners":number,"missing_americans":number,' +
        '"rescued":number,"impacted_total":number,"powerloss_mw":number,' +
        '"source":"URL","last_updated":"ISO8601"} ' +
        "No markdown. No explanation. JSON only.",
      messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Get latest Nepal 2026 flood figures now." }],
    });

    const text = response.content
      .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
      .map((b) => (b as { type: "text"; text: string }).text)
      .join("");
    const clean  = text.replace(/```json|```/g, "").trim();
    const parsed = JSON.parse(clean) as Partial<LiveStats>;
    if (typeof parsed.deaths_total !== "number") return null;
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function POST() {
  // Run all sources concurrently with independent timeouts
  const [bipad, reliefweb, anthropic] = await Promise.allSettled([
    fetchBIPAD(),
    fetchReliefWeb(),
    fetchViaAnthropic(),
  ]);

  const bipadData     = bipad.status     === "fulfilled" ? bipad.value     : null;
  const reliefwebData = reliefweb.status === "fulfilled" ? reliefweb.value : null;
  const anthropicData = anthropic.status === "fulfilled" ? anthropic.value : null;

  const anyLive = bipadData ?? anthropicData ?? reliefwebData;

  // Merge: static base → Anthropic (news) → ReliefWeb (timestamp) → BIPAD (override)
  const merged: LiveStats = {
    ...LIVE_STATS,
    ...(anthropicData ?? {}),
    ...(reliefwebData ?? {}),
    ...(bipadData     ?? {}),
    fallback: !anyLive,
  };

  return Response.json(merged, { status: 200 });
}
```

## Phase 6 — Cron Job (`src/app/api/cron/route.ts`)

Auto-triggers the refresh pipeline every 10 minutes on Vercel.

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Vercel cron trigger
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
//
// Fires POST /api/refresh every 10 minutes.
// Add CRON_SECRET to .env.local (openssl rand -hex 32).
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const runtime = "edge";

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const auth = request.headers.get("authorization");
  if (auth !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new Response("Unauthorized", { status: 401 });
  }
  try {
    await fetch(`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/refresh`, {
      method: "POST",
    });
    return Response.json({
      triggered:   true,
      at:          new Date().toISOString(),
      description: "Nepal flood map data refresh triggered",
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return Response.json({ triggered: false, error: String(err) }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

## Phase 7 — Map Component (`src/components/FloodMap.tsx`)

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Interactive Mapbox GL JS map
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
//
// Features:
//   - Animated flood flow path (line-dasharray animation, south-flowing)
//   - Severity-coded circle markers with popups
//   - Pulsing origin marker
//   - Leaflet/OSM fallback if NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN is absent
//   - Mobile-responsive legend
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { FLOOD_ORIGIN, FLOOD_LOCATIONS, RIVER_FLOW_PATH } from "@/data/floodData";
import type { FloodLocation } from "@/types/flood";

const SEVERITY_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  critical: "#ef4444",
  high:     "#f97316",
  medium:   "#eab308",
};

// ── Mapbox implementation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MapboxMap() {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mapRef       = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    (async () => {
      const mapboxgl = (await import("mapbox-gl")).default;
      await import("mapbox-gl/dist/mapbox-gl.css" as any); // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      if (cancelled || !containerRef.current) return;

      mapboxgl.accessToken = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN!;

      const map = new mapboxgl.Map({
        container: containerRef.current,
        style:     "mapbox://styles/mapbox/dark-v11",
        center:    [85.3, 28.0],
        zoom:      7.5,
      });
      mapRef.current = map;

      map.on("load", () => {
        // ── Flow path ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        map.addSource("flood-path", {
          type: "geojson",
          data: {
            type:     "Feature",
            geometry: { type: "LineString", coordinates: RIVER_FLOW_PATH },
            properties: {},
          },
        });
        // Glow layer (wider, semi-transparent)
        map.addLayer({
          id:     "flood-path-glow",
          type:   "line",
          source: "flood-path",
          paint:  { "line-color": "#ef4444", "line-width": 8, "line-opacity": 0.25 },
        });
        // Animated dash layer
        map.addLayer({
          id:     "flood-path-animated",
          type:   "line",
          source: "flood-path",
          paint: {
            "line-color":      "#ef4444",
            "line-width":      3,
            "line-dasharray":  [0, 4, 3],
          },
        });

        // Animate dasharray to simulate flow
        let step = 0;
        const dashArraySeq = [
          [0, 4, 3], [0.5, 4, 2.5], [1, 4, 2], [1.5, 4, 1.5],
          [2, 4, 1], [2.5, 4, 0.5], [3, 4, 0], [0, 0.5, 3, 3.5],
        ];
        function animateDash() {
          map.setPaintProperty(
            "flood-path-animated",
            "line-dasharray",
            dashArraySeq[step % dashArraySeq.length]
          );
          step++;
          requestAnimationFrame(animateDash);
        }
        animateDash();

        // ── Location markers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        map.addSource("locations", {
          type: "geojson",
          data: {
            type:     "FeatureCollection",
            features: FLOOD_LOCATIONS.map((loc) => ({
              type:       "Feature",
              geometry:   { type: "Point", coordinates: [loc.lng, loc.lat] },
              properties: loc,
            })),
          },
        });

        map.addLayer({
          id:     "locations-circle",
          type:   "circle",
          source: "locations",
          paint: {
            "circle-radius":       8,
            "circle-color":        [
              "match",
              ["get", "severity"],
              "critical", "#ef4444",
              "high",     "#f97316",
              "medium",   "#eab308",
              "#94a3b8",
            ],
            "circle-stroke-color": "#0f172a",
            "circle-stroke-width": 2,
            "circle-opacity":      0.9,
          },
        });

        // Popup on click
        map.on("click", "locations-circle", (e: any) => {
          if (!e.features?.length) return;
          const props = e.features[0].properties as FloodLocation;
          new mapboxgl.Popup({ maxWidth: "320px" })
            .setLngLat(e.lngLat)
            .setHTML(`
              <div style="font-family:sans-serif;color:#1e293b;padding:4px">
                <strong style="font-size:14px">${props.name}</strong>
                <div style="margin:6px 0;font-size:12px;color:#64748b">
                  ${props.district} · ${props.time}
                </div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;margin-bottom:6px">
                  ${props.lat.toFixed(4)}°N, ${props.lng.toFixed(4)}°E
                </div>
                <div style="font-size:12px">${props.detail}</div>
              </div>
            `)
            .addTo(map);
        });
        map.on("mouseenter", "locations-circle", () => {
          map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer";
        });
        map.on("mouseleave", "locations-circle", () => {
          map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "";
        });

        // ── Pulsing origin marker ───────────────────────────────────────────
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "pulse-marker";
        el.style.cssText = `
          width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
          background:#ef4444;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0.6);
          animation:pulse 2s infinite;
        `;
        const style = document.createElement("style");
        style.textContent = `
          @keyframes pulse {
            0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0.6); }
            70%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 14px rgba(239,68,68,0); }
            100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0); }
          }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);

        new mapboxgl.Marker({ element: el })
          .setLngLat([FLOOD_ORIGIN.lng, FLOOD_ORIGIN.lat])
          .setPopup(
            new mapboxgl.Popup({ offset: 20 }).setHTML(
              `<strong>${FLOOD_ORIGIN.name}</strong><br/>
               <small>${FLOOD_ORIGIN.time}</small><br/>
               <small>${FLOOD_ORIGIN.description.slice(0, 120)}…</small>`
            )
          )
          .addTo(map);
      });
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      mapRef.current?.remove();
    };
  }, []);

  return <div ref={containerRef} className="w-full h-full rounded-lg" />;
}

// ── Leaflet fallback (no API key needed) ──────────────────────────────────────
function LeafletMap() {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      const L = (await import("leaflet")).default;
      await import("leaflet/dist/leaflet.css" as any); // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      if (cancelled || !containerRef.current) return;

      const map = L.map(containerRef.current).setView([28.0, 85.3], 8);
      L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
        attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors",
      }).addTo(map);

      FLOOD_LOCATIONS.forEach((loc) => {
        L.circleMarker([loc.lat, loc.lng], {
          radius:      9,
          color:       SEVERITY_COLORS[loc.severity] ?? "#94a3b8",
          fillOpacity: 0.85,
        })
          .bindPopup(`<strong>${loc.name}</strong><br/>${loc.time}<br/>${loc.detail}`)
          .addTo(map);
      });

      L.circleMarker([FLOOD_ORIGIN.lat, FLOOD_ORIGIN.lng], {
        radius: 12, color: "#ef4444", fillOpacity: 1,
      })
        .bindPopup(`<strong>${FLOOD_ORIGIN.name}</strong><br/>${FLOOD_ORIGIN.time}`)
        .addTo(map);

      L.polyline(
        RIVER_FLOW_PATH.map(([lng, lat]) => [lat, lng] as [number, number]),
        { color: "#ef4444", weight: 3, opacity: 0.8, dashArray: "8, 6" }
      ).addTo(map);
    })();

    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  return <div ref={containerRef} className="w-full h-full rounded-lg" />;
}

// ── Exported component (auto-selects based on token presence) ─────────────────
export default function FloodMap() {
  const hasToken = Boolean(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN);
  const [legendOpen, setLegendOpen] = useState(true);

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-full min-h-[500px]">
      {hasToken ? <MapboxMap /> : <LeafletMap />}

      {/* Legend */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 z-10">
        {legendOpen ? (
          <div className="bg-gray-900/90 text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-3 space-y-1.5 backdrop-blur">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <span className="font-semibold text-sm">Legend</span>
              <button onClick={() => setLegendOpen(false)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white ml-4">✕</button>
            </div>
            {Object.entries(SEVERITY_COLORS).map(([k, v]) => (
              <div key={k} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full" style={{ background: v }} />
                <span className="capitalize">{k} severity</span>
              </div>
            ))}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-gray-700">
              <span className="inline-block w-6 h-0.5 bg-red-500" />
              <span>Flood path ↓ south</span>
            </div>
            {/* Generated by Claude note */}
            <div className="pt-1 border-t border-gray-700 text-gray-500 text-[10px]">
              Data verified by Claude · Anthropic · Aug 29 2026
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={() => setLegendOpen(true)}
            className="bg-gray-900/90 text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-2 backdrop-blur">
            Legend
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Phase 8 — Live Dashboard (`src/components/LiveDashboard.tsx`)

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Live stats dashboard
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
//
// Auto-refreshes every 60s via /api/refresh (multi-source agentic pipeline).
// Also polls GDACS every 5 min for secondary event alerts.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Cell } from "recharts";
import { LIVE_STATS, ACTIVE_ALERTS, MISSING_BY_NATIONALITY } from "@/data/floodData";
import { checkGDACS } from "@/lib/gdacs";
import type { LiveStats, ActiveAlert, GDACSAlert } from "@/types/flood";

const REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS  = 60_000;  // stats
const GDACS_INTERVAL_MS    = 300_000; // GDACS alert check

const SEVERITY_BG: Record<string, string> = {
  critical: "border-red-500",
  warning:  "border-orange-400",
  info:     "border-blue-400",
};

function StatCard({ label, value, unit }: { label: string; value: number; unit?: string }) {
  const prevRef  = useRef(value);
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (value !== prevRef.current) {
      setFlash(true);
      setTimeout(() => setFlash(false), 600);
      prevRef.current = value;
    }
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <div className={`bg-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 transition-transform duration-300 ${flash ? "scale-105" : ""}`}>
      <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
        {value.toLocaleString()}{unit && <span className="text-sm font-normal text-gray-400 ml-1">{unit}</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function LiveDashboard() {
  const [stats,    setStats]    = useState<LiveStats>(LIVE_STATS);
  const [alerts,   setAlerts]   = useState<ActiveAlert[]>(ACTIVE_ALERTS);
  const [gdacs,    setGdacs]    = useState<GDACSAlert | null>(null);
  const [isStale,  setIsStale]  = useState(false);
  const lastFetch = useRef(Date.now());

  async function refresh() {
    try {
      const res  = await fetch("/api/refresh", { method: "POST" });
      const data = await res.json() as LiveStats;
      setStats(data);
      lastFetch.current = Date.now();
      setIsStale(false);
    } catch {
      setIsStale(true);
    }
  }

  async function pollGDACS() {
    const alert = await checkGDACS();
    setGdacs(alert);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    refresh();
    pollGDACS();
    const statsTimer = setInterval(refresh,    REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS);
    const gdacsTimer = setInterval(pollGDACS,  GDACS_INTERVAL_MS);
    const staleTimer = setInterval(() => {
      setIsStale(Date.now() - lastFetch.current > 5 * 60_000);
    }, 30_000);
    return () => { clearInterval(statsTimer); clearInterval(gdacsTimer); clearInterval(staleTimer); };
  }, []);

  const dismissAlert = (i: number) => {
    setAlerts((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 text-white">

      {/* Live badge */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${isStale ? "bg-amber-400" : "bg-green-400 animate-pulse"}`} />
        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">
          {isStale ? "Data may be stale" : "Live"} · refreshes every 60s
        </span>
        {stats.fallback && (
          <span className="text-xs text-amber-400 ml-2">(cached data)</span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* GDACS secondary alert */}
      {gdacs?.alertLevel && gdacs.alertLevel !== "green" && (
        <div className={`border-l-4 rounded p-3 text-sm ${gdacs.alertLevel === "red" ? "border-red-500 bg-red-950/40" : "border-orange-400 bg-orange-950/40"}`}>
          <div className="font-semibold">⚠ GDACS {gdacs.alertLevel.toUpperCase()} Alert</div>
          <div className="text-gray-300 mt-1">{gdacs.title}</div>
          {gdacs.link && <a href={gdacs.link} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-blue-400 text-xs mt-1 block">View on GDACS →</a>}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Active alerts */}
      {alerts.map((alert, i) => (
        <div key={i} className={`border-l-4 rounded p-3 text-sm bg-gray-800/60 ${SEVERITY_BG[alert.level]}`}>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
            <span className="font-semibold">{alert.title}</span>
            {alert.dismissible !== false ? (
              <button onClick={() => dismissAlert(i)} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-white ml-2 text-xs">✕</button>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-gray-600 text-xs ml-2" title="Cannot dismiss — active critical alert">🔒</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="text-gray-300 mt-1">{alert.detail}</div>
        </div>
      ))}

      {/* Stat grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <StatCard label="Deaths (Nepal)"      value={stats.deaths_nepal} />
        <StatCard label="Deaths (Tibet)"      value={stats.deaths_tibet} />
        <StatCard label="Missing (Nepal)"     value={stats.missing_nepal} />
        <StatCard label="Missing (foreigners)"value={stats.missing_foreigners} />
        <StatCard label="Americans missing"   value={stats.missing_americans} />
        <StatCard label="Rescued / airlifted" value={stats.rescued} />
        <StatCard label="People impacted"     value={stats.impacted_total} />
        <StatCard label="Power lost"          value={stats.powerloss_mw} unit="MW" />
        <StatCard label="Bridges destroyed"   value={stats.bridges_destroyed} />
        <StatCard label="Roads destroyed"     value={stats.roads_destroyed_km} unit="km" />
      </div>

      {/* Missing by nationality chart */}
      <div>
        <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wide">Missing by Nationality</div>
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={160}>
          <BarChart data={MISSING_BY_NATIONALITY} layout="vertical" margin={{ left: 90 }}>
            <XAxis type="number" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "#94a3b8" }} />
            <YAxis type="category" dataKey="country" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "#94a3b8" }} width={90} />
            <Tooltip
              contentStyle={{ background: "#1e293b", border: "none", fontSize: 12 }}
              formatter={(v: number, _: string, entry: any) =>
                [`${v} missing`, entry.payload.source]}
            />
            <Bar dataKey="count" radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]}>
              {MISSING_BY_NATIONALITY.map((_, i) => (
                <Cell key={i} fill={i === 0 ? "#ef4444" : i === 1 ? "#f97316" : "#eab308"} />
              ))}
            </Bar>
          </BarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      {/* Source attribution */}
      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-600 border-t border-gray-800 pt-2">
        Source: {stats.source} · Updated: {new Date(stats.last_updated).toUTCString()}
        <br />
        Generated by Claude · Anthropic · claude.ai
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Phase 9 — Timeline (`src/components/FloodTimeline.tsx`)

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Event timeline
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { TIMELINE_EVENTS }             from "@/data/floodData";

export default function FloodTimeline() {
  const [visible,  setVisible]  = useState(false);
  const [atBottom, setAtBottom] = useState(true);
  const endRef    = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => { setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 100); }, []);

  const scrollToLatest = () => endRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });

  const onScroll = () => {
    const el = scrollRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    setAtBottom(el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 20);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <div
        ref={scrollRef}
        onScroll={onScroll}
        className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-2"
      >
        <div className="relative border-l-2 border-gray-700 ml-4 space-y-0">
          {TIMELINE_EVENTS.map((ev, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className="relative pl-8 pb-8 transition-all duration-500"
              style={{
                opacity:   visible ? 1 : 0,
                transform: visible ? "translateY(0)" : "translateY(16px)",
                transitionDelay: `${i * 150}ms`,
              }}
            >
              {/* Dot */}
              <span className={`absolute -left-[9px] top-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2
                ${i === TIMELINE_EVENTS.length - 1
                  ? "bg-amber-400 border-amber-300 animate-pulse"
                  : "bg-gray-700 border-gray-500"}`}
              />
              {/* Time badge */}
              <span className="inline-block font-mono text-xs bg-gray-800 text-gray-300
                rounded px-2 py-0.5 mb-1">
                {ev.time}
              </span>
              {/* Title */}
              <div className={`font-semibold text-sm mb-1
                ${i === TIMELINE_EVENTS.length - 1 ? "text-amber-400" : "text-white"}`}>
                {ev.event}
                {i === TIMELINE_EVENTS.length - 1 && (
                  <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-amber-500">ONGOING</span>
                )}
              </div>
              {/* Detail */}
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-300">{ev.detail}</div>
              {/* Source */}
              <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-600 mt-1 italic">Source: {ev.source}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div ref={endRef} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {!atBottom && (
        <button
          onClick={scrollToLatest}
          className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 bg-amber-500 text-black text-xs
            font-semibold rounded px-3 py-1 shadow-lg hover:bg-amber-400 transition"
        >
          Jump to latest ↓
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Phase 10 — Coordinate Table (`src/components/CoordinateTable.tsx`)

```typescript
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Nepal Flood Map — Coordinate table with CSV export
// Generated by Claude (Anthropic) — claude.ai
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FLOOD_ORIGIN, FLOOD_LOCATIONS } from "@/data/floodData";
import type { FloodLocation, Severity }  from "@/types/flood";

type SortKey = "time" | "severity" | "district";

const SEVERITY_ORDER: Record<Severity, number> = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2 };
const SEVERITY_COLOR: Record<Severity, string> = {
  critical: "text-red-400",
  high:     "text-orange-400",
  medium:   "text-yellow-400",
};

// Synthesize origin as a location row
const ORIGIN_ROW: FloodLocation = {
  id: 0, name: FLOOD_ORIGIN.name, lat: FLOOD_ORIGIN.lat, lng: FLOOD_ORIGIN.lng,
  time: FLOOD_ORIGIN.time, district: FLOOD_ORIGIN.district,
  type: "origin", severity: "critical",
  detail: FLOOD_ORIGIN.description,
};
const ALL_ROWS = [ORIGIN_ROW, ...FLOOD_LOCATIONS];

function copyToClipboard(text: string, cb: () => void) {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(cb).catch(() => {});
}

export default function CoordinateTable() {
  const [sortKey,     setSortKey]     = useState<SortKey>("time");
  const [sortAsc,     setSortAsc]     = useState(true);
  const [district,    setDistrict]    = useState("All");
  const [copiedId,    setCopiedId]    = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [csvCopied,   setCsvCopied]   = useState(false);

  const districts = ["All", ...Array.from(new Set(ALL_ROWS.map((r) => r.district)))];

  const sorted = [...ALL_ROWS]
    .filter((r) => district === "All" || r.district === district)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      let cmp = 0;
      if (sortKey === "severity") cmp = SEVERITY_ORDER[a.severity] - SEVERITY_ORDER[b.severity];
      if (sortKey === "district") cmp = a.district.localeCompare(b.district);
      if (sortKey === "time")     cmp = a.time.localeCompare(b.time);
      return sortAsc ? cmp : -cmp;
    });

  function toggleSort(key: SortKey) {
    if (sortKey === key) setSortAsc((v) => !v);
    else { setSortKey(key); setSortAsc(true); }
  }

  function exportCSV() {
    const header = "name,district,lat,lng,time,severity,detail";
    const rows   = ALL_ROWS.map((r) =>
      `"${r.name}","${r.district}",${r.lat},${r.lng},"${r.time}","${r.severity}","${r.detail.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
    );
    const csv    = [header, ...rows].join("\n");
    const blob   = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url    = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a      = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = "nepal-flood-2026-coordinates.csv"; a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setCsvCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCsvCopied(false), 2000);
  }

  const SortBtn = ({ k, label }: { k: SortKey; label: string }) => (
    <button onClick={() => toggleSort(k)}
      className="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-white transition">
      {label}
      <span className="text-gray-600">{sortKey === k ? (sortAsc ? "↑" : "↓") : "↕"}</span>
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
        <select value={district} onChange={(e) => setDistrict(e.target.value)}
          className="bg-gray-800 text-white text-sm rounded px-3 py-1.5 border border-gray-700">
          {districts.map((d) => <option key={d}>{d}</option>)}
        </select>
        <button onClick={exportCSV}
          className="bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white text-sm rounded px-3 py-1.5 transition">
          {csvCopied ? "✓ Downloading…" : "Export CSV"}
        </button>
        <span className="text-gray-500 text-xs">{sorted.length} locations</span>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-gray-800">
        <table className="w-full text-sm text-left">
          <thead className="bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 text-xs uppercase">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-3 py-2">Name</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2"><SortBtn k="district" label="District" /></th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2">Lat</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2">Lng</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2"><SortBtn k="time"     label="Time Hit" /></th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2"><SortBtn k="severity" label="Severity" /></th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2">Copy</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-800">
            {sorted.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id}
                className="hover:bg-gray-800/60 transition-colors">
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-white font-medium">{row.name}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-400">{row.district}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono text-gray-300">{row.lat.toFixed(4)}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono text-gray-300">{row.lng.toFixed(4)}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap">{row.time}</td>
                <td className={`px-3 py-2 capitalize font-medium ${SEVERITY_COLOR[row.severity]}`}>
                  {row.severity}
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard(`${row.lat},${row.lng}`, () => {
                      setCopiedId(row.id);
                      setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1500);
                    })}
                    className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-white transition">
                    {copiedId === row.id ? "✓" : "Copy"}
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Footer note */}
      <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-700">
        Coordinates verified by Claude · Anthropic · claude.ai · Aug 29 2026
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
